searchText: The same issue exists with the hardcoding approach. Every downstream chain has to plug in the hardcoded addresses 🙃 It is a conflict of spec between 7610 and 7928 if you want to implement both correctly as Garry explained. Also ambiguous spec because the tests implement the current version of the EIP-7610 correctly but miss the need for its hardcoded nature post 7928. Yeah, EIP-7610 never should have existed. Most of chain started after state clear happened, so they dont have problem with empty account with storage And this is not even problem for eth mainnet. <@402853454126776320> you can drop this hardcoded map even now, and it will work without risk! One of the L2s had a significant amount of 7610 accounts post merge, so it's not a non-issue. If we are on track to ship this to testnet this really should be escalated to the other client teams.
